must_identify.evidence: The root cause was a typo in the container image tag introduced in revision 2 of the frontend Deployment: `nginx:1.27-alpne` instead of `nginx:1.27-alpine` [6, 11]. This nonexistent tag caused repeated image pull failures (ImagePullBackOff) on the new pod [8], preventing it from ever reaching Ready.

must_identify.evidence: User-facing impact was limited: both revision-1 pods (correct image) remained Running/Ready throughout and continued serving traffic [7, 12].
